# ScamShield AI

> ScamShield AI is an AI-powered, multi-channel scam detection and correlation platform. It analyzes SMS messages, emails, URLs, QR codes, and job offers, then correlates suspicious events across channels to reveal coordinated scam campaigns.

ScamShield AI runs a multi-agent engine (URL, Text/SMS, Email, Job, QR and a Correlation agent) orchestrated with LangGraph. Each item receives a risk score (0-100), a severity (Safe / Suspicious / High Risk), extracted indicators, and a plain-language analyst summary.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](https://www.scamshield-ai.com/): threat overview, statistics and recent detections
- [Analyze](https://www.scamshield-ai.com/analyze): submit an SMS, email, URL, QR image or job offer for analysis
- [Scam Network](https://www.scamshield-ai.com/network): interactive graph of events linked by shared indicators
- [History](https://www.scamshield-ai.com/history): filterable log of all analyzed items
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.scamshield-ai.com/privacy): data handling, retention and security
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.scamshield-ai.com/terms): service terms and acceptable use

## Notes

- The core differentiator is cross-channel correlation: matching shared phones, domains, emails and company names to group separate events into a single scam campaign.
- A Demo Mode runs the full experience offline on realistic sample data.
